name: Split Dive Left
purpose: The near back straight ahead, through the first gap outside the center. Against a nose — the 5-3 and the 5-4-2 — the center and the playside guard double him and the ball runs right off it. The 4-4 has no nose, so the guard drives the man over him and the center climbs instead. The aiming point never changes. This one has to work before anything else in the formation does — it holds their linebackers inside and makes the pitch go.

QB.rule: Open left, hand to the near back at two yards, then fake the pitch away.

LH.rule: Aim at the center's outside hip every time. Get north — there is no hole to find.

RH.rule: Run the pitch path away at full speed with your arms tucked. You are the lie.

coaching_points: Snap to handoff should be under a second. If the back is waiting on the ball, the play is already dead.
The back away from the ball runs his pitch path every single time. Two backs means the fake is half the play, not a spare part of it.
The ball carrier runs at a spot, not at a defender. Give him the outside hip of the center and let him go.
Run it both ways. Once their middle linebacker knows which gap the dive hits, it stops being quick.
